Interface LocatedHttpRouteGroup<T>

Type Parameters:
T - The type of the located target
All Superinterfaces:
ExecutionSpec<LocatedHttpRouteGroup<T>>, HttpRouteScope, LocatedHttpRouteScope<T>, RouteFilterSpec<LocatedHttpRouteGroup<T>>, RouteSpec<LocatedHttpRouteGroup<T>>
public sealed interface LocatedHttpRouteGroup<T> extends LocatedHttpRouteScope<T>, RouteSpec<LocatedHttpRouteGroup<T>>
A group of the routes of located targets of a type, declared with LocatedHttpRouteScope.group(Consumer) or, under a prefix, with LocatedHttpRouteScope.path(String, Consumer): a HttpRouteGroup of a LocatedHttpRouteBuilder, whose routes and locators receive the located target, like the ones of the builder. Its filters, settings, error routes and status routes apply to the routes of the group, as for an HttpRouteGroup. 
public void routes(LocatedHttpRouteBuilder<Order> order) {
    order.path("/items", items -> {
        items.error(NoSuchElementException.class, (request, error) -> HttpResponse.notFound());
        items.GET("/{item}").handle((request, pathVariables, current) ->
            HttpResponse.ok(current.item(pathVariables.getInt("item"))));
        items.locate("/{item}/parts", (request, pathVariables, current) -> current.item(pathVariables.getInt("item")), partRoutes);
    });
}
